column7: After a DEK rotation killed between its sweep commit and the dek.key.pending rename, upgrade-aad, rotate-kek, migrate-provider and auth-encryption rotate/migrate discarded, overwrote or wrote around the pending new DEK, losing every swept row; every key writer now runs RecoverInterruptedRotation under the exclusive key lock first (openKeyWriter). Class guard: ./internal/encryption TestCleanPendingDEK_OnlyBehindTheRedoMarker.
